newsitem.title: USA: ICTS Int'l files for public offering.
newsitem.headline: ICTS Int'l files for public offering.

text.p: ICTS International N.V. said on Wednesday that it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission relating to a proposed public offering of its common shares.

The Dutch aviation security firm said in a statement that it would offer 900,000 common shares. ICTS also has granted to its underwriters an overallotment option of up to 165,000 common shares. In addition, 200,000 common shares are being offered by certain selling shareholders. Unterberg Harris will lead manage the offering and Josephthal Lyon & Ross Inc will serve as co-manager.
